compute_multiview_depth_confidence: compute per-pixel confidence scores based on multi-view depth projection consistency across camera views
compute_frustum_intersection_matrix: compute a frustum intersection matrix to find which camera view pairs have overlapping fields of view
project_pts3d_to_image_with_depth: project 3D points in camera frame to the image plane returning x, y, and depth values
in_image: check if projected 2D points with depth fall within valid image boundaries and minimum depth threshold
review_compute_multiview_depth_confidenc: review the compute_multiview_depth_confidence function to understand how depth consistency confidence is computed per pixel
